test_title: PYST 25: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 1 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Three statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All nodes are joints.

Some joints are bones.

All bones are cartilages.

**Conclusions:**

I. No node is a bone.

II. All joints are cartilages.

III. Some cartilages are nodes.

options.text: Only conclusions II and III follow
Only conclusions I and II follow

solution:
From the given statements, the Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/120eba919b0329e11949f79943d628d3e715cc482b0ccb05d4b79cf62b4ee313.png] 

Now we consider the given conclusions:

**I. No node is a bone **→ Does not follow → As some joints are bones and all nodes are joints so there is a possibility that some nodes are bones and thus the conclusion does not follow.

**II. All joints are cartilages **→ Does not follow → As some joints are bones and all bones are cartilages so it can be said that some joints are cartilages but not all and therefore the conclusion does not follow.

**III. Some cartilages are nodes**→ Does not follow → As some cartilages with nodes and we cannot assume any relationship and from the figure we can see that no cartilages are nodes so the conclusion does not follow.

Since no conclusions follow.** **

Hence **the correct answer is option 4)**
